claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves Innokin iTaste MVP 2.0 2600mAh 3C as a 2600mAh preset with a 3C runtime rating.
The Innokin iTaste MVP 2.0 manual identifies a built-in polymer lithium-ion rechargeable battery.
The exact catalog entry Innokin iTaste MVP 2.0 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2013-09-27 or earlier.
